entities.name: UE network capability
entities.description: Information element indicating the network capabilities supported by the UE.

entities.name: Periodic tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE for periodic tracking area updates.

entities.name: Unless performing periodic tracking area updating
entities.description: Condition specifying that the UE network capability IE is included unless the UE is performing a periodic tracking area updating procedure.

relations.description: The inclusion of the UE network capability IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is not performing a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
The condition is defined by the absence of the periodic tracking area updating procedure.
